market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. US-Iran strikes and Warsh hawkishness create a two-front pressure on equities. Oil above recent highs, EM selling, Nasdaq capped. NIO earnings (Sept 1) and Shein IPO provide selective catalysts. Bond markets in tug-of-war: buying Warsh's tough talk but skeptical of sustained hikes. Expect 2-3% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle ($31B memory, SpaceX $100B, Nvidia financing) supports semis/infrastructure through 2027. Solar tipping point and BYD charging network validate energy transition. EM bonds attractive on dollar debasement. Key risk: if Iran conflict escalates beyond current strikes, oil >$100 scenario pressures global growth. Fed path is the swing factor—Warsh's credibility test in Q4 2026.
